title: Magic UI Bento Grid component
lede: An open-source React component that lays out feature cards as a bento grid, published by Magic UI in November 2023.
summary: MIT-licensed React and Tailwind bento grid: white cards with a 12 px radius in one- and two-column spans. Magic UI, 2023.

evidence.note: Captured the live documentation page at 1440 × 900 on 2026-10-02 with `tools/capture.mjs` and inspected it. Read the component source `apps/www/registry/magicui/bento-grid.tsx` and the demo `apps/www/registry/example/bento-demo.tsx` in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/magicuidesign/magicui). The stored image is a 728 × 382 crop of the first row of the demo.

styles.note: Partial fit: tiles of different spans with one gap, but the radius is small (12 px) and the light cards carry a faint shadow instead of a tonal step.

context: The documentation page, dated 2023-11-09 in its source file, describes the component as “a layout used to showcase the features of a product in a simple and elegant way”.

The source sets the grid to three columns with `gap-4` (16 px) and rows of 22 rem. Each card is `rounded-xl` (12 px) and spans one or two columns; on small screens every card spans all three columns. Light cards use a 1 px shadow ring at 3 % black plus two soft shadows at 5 %. Dark cards use a 1 px border at 10 % white and an inset glow.

The repository is under the MIT License (“Copyright (c) Magic UI”). It was created on 2023-06-26 and the component file was first committed on 2025-09-15 at its current path; the docs date shows that the component is older than that path.
observed: Two white cards sit side by side on a white panel: a narrow card on the left and a card about twice as wide on the right, separated by a narrow gap.
Both cards have rounded corners of the same small radius and a very faint shadow; there is no visible outline.
Each card carries one feature: a thin line icon, a semibold dark grey heading (“Save your files”, “Notifications”), and one light grey sentence.
The upper half of each card holds a faded, masked illustration of the feature: blurred file cards in the left card and notification rows in the right card.
interpretation: The component reduces the bento grid to a reusable pattern for SaaS feature sections. It keeps the unequal spans and the one-feature-per-tile rule, but uses the small radius and soft shadow of shadcn/ui cards, so it sits between the core look and [Material Design](style:material-design) cards.
borrow: Put a faded, masked illustration of the feature in the top half of the tile and the heading and one sentence in the bottom half.
Define spans per card (`col-span-1` or `col-span-2` on a three-column grid) and let every card span the full width on small screens.

images.alt: Two white rounded cards side by side: a narrow card with blurred file previews, a document icon, and the heading Save your files; a wide card with faded notification rows, a bell icon, and the heading Notifications.
